opening: I have pain in my heel.
It came on gradually over the past 2 weeks.
When it hurts, it can get up to a 7 out of 10.
Occasionally I take ibuprofen for the pain.

opening.text: I've been having pain in my heel for the past two weeks, and it came on gradually. It feels like a stretching, tearing pain, and it can get up to a 7 out of 10 when it's bad. I'm a runner, and I occasionally take ibuprofen for it. My father has arthritis.
